name: Jaunt
body:
Design manipulation (teleportation); Level 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Targets you
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You instantly transfer yourself from your current location to any other spot within range. This functions as a dimension door spell, except as noted here.

Overload: For every runic charge overloaded into this script, the range increases by 100 feet. If you overload at least three runic charges into this script, you can take any remaining actions you have that turn.
